Fairies and Fusiliers

Corbis

Old Mr. Philosopher Comes for Ben and Claire, / An ugly man, a tall man, / With bright-red hair.

—“
Mr. Philosopher
”

Robert

Graves

Fairies and Fusiliers

Robert Graves

A versatile and highly prolific writer, Graves considered himself primarily a poet; his poems were characterized by gracefulness and lucidity. Much of Graves’s poetry focuses on his experiences in World War I—as evidenced in the 46 of this collection.
